method: Deterministic TF-IDF cosine over original stem plus every choice, unigram [a-z]+|[0-9]+; 1+ln(tf), ln(1+N/(1+df)); excludes self. Scores only nominate candidates; manual semantic reading required. Canonical/public inputs are reduced immediately to ID/stem/all options/collection only. No keys, hidden truth, authors or review metadata enter comparison.

canonical_nearest.stem: One Massachusetts pharmacist is supervising one certified pharmacy technician and two pharmacy technicians. Another employee holds a current pharmacy technician license but is assigned only to the front register and initially performs no professional pharmacy support. During a rush, the manager directs that employee to enter prescription data. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: While the employee performs only cashier duties and no professional pharmacy support, the employee may be excluded from the support-personnel ratio.
Once the employee begins prescription data entry, the cashier label no longer keeps the employee outside the ratio.
The resulting four-person support team is permitted because every member holds a pharmacy personnel credential.
The employee remains excluded for the entire shift because the schedule lists the employee as a cashier.
The data-entry assignment must satisfy technician scope and supervision rules independently of the numerical ratio analysis.

choices.text: The medication is non-patient-specific Schedule VI stock

canonical_nearest.stem: Every option below involves gabapentin stock at an otherwise eligible Massachusetts hospital ADD. Which stocking actions are permitted under the current technician-stocking policy? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A nationally certified licensed technician uses the no-prior-pharmacist-verification Schedule VI shortcut for gabapentin.
A nationally certified licensed technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin under the ordinary supervised licensed-technician pathway.
A pharmacy technician trainee loads unverified gabapentin based only on a visual bottle check.
A pharmacy technician trainee loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using required electronic validation under pharmacist direction and supervision.
A licensed non-trainee pharmacy technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using electronic validation under pharmacist supervision.

canonical_nearest.stem: Before dispensing a new prescription, a Massachusetts pharmacist's prospective review identifies a clinically significant interaction. Which actions are consistent with the current prospective drug-review duty? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Let a technician independently resolve the interaction if the dispensing software supplies a recommended override code.
Skip prospective review because the prescriber sent the prescription electronically.
Ensure the pharmacist conducts prospective drug review before the new prescription is dispensed or delivered.
Automatically refuse every prescription that generates an alert without considering the specific problem or communicating when appropriate.
Take appropriate measures to resolve an identified therapy problem, which may include consultation with the prescriber or patient and documentation of the measures taken.

canonical_nearest.stem: During prospective drug utilization review, the pharmacy system flags a clinically significant conflict. A certified pharmacy technician tells the pharmacist that the technician can clear the alert under the pharmacy's protocol and that documentation is needed only if the prescriber is called. Which statements correctly describe the Massachusetts requirements? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacist must determine what measures are appropriate in response to the DUR finding and may choose consultation with the prescriber, the patient, or the patient's agent when appropriate.
The pharmacist must document the measures taken in response to the DUR finding, not only a prescriber call.
A certified pharmacy technician may resolve the clinical conflict independently when an approved protocol supplies the decision steps.
Every DUR finding requires prescriber consultation before dispensing, regardless of the pharmacist's clinical assessment.
Documentation is optional when the pharmacist addresses the issue directly with the patient rather than the prescriber.

canonical_nearest.stem: With the pharmacist on duty's approval, a Massachusetts certified pharmacy technician identifies themself by title before speaking with a prescriber's office about an existing patient. Which actions may the certified technician perform? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Request authorization for another refill of an existing prescription.
Receive a missing quantity for a prescription already transmitted to the pharmacy.
Recommend and accept a higher dose in response to the patient's recent symptoms.
Resolve a drug-utilization-review alert raised by the pharmacy system.
Counsel the patient on how to manage adverse effects from the medication.
